author: Marco Romanzin
text: Had full knee replacement surgery. Blair and his team worked with me and set me up to make a full and complete recovery. They provide all the tools and advice to get me back to full mobility. They are fun, friendly and professional. For whatever ails you, got check them out, you won't be disappointed!

author: Arlene Carlson
text: Hanna has been so helpful and given me useful advice and adaptive tools. Maybe I'm not just on a greasy downhill slide! Thanks.

author: Trevor
text: Blair and his crew did a great job of rehabbing my diffuse knee injury. They got it stabilized and set up on rehab and a brace immediately post injury. Once it was determined that my knee didn’t require surgery, the focus became extensive rehab with progressive exercises and movements to get my leg and knee as strong and functional as possible. 3 months in and I have regained over 90% of pre injury function, have minimal pain, and I have the confidence to get back to all of my pre injury activities. Thanks so much for all the time, treatment and care! I have being coming Nose Creek for over 20 years and they have got me back to almost normal every time!!

author: Dorina Amadi
text: I had a great experience with Rizelle when I came in for treatment for my knee pain

author: A G
text: I had a great experience with Dr. Eileen Wei at Nose Creek Physiotherapy. I came in with L4/5 pain that was especially bad at night, and honestly, I was skeptical about acupuncture. Previous experiences hadn't done much for me. After the first visit, I started feeling relief in my lower back. After each treatment session, the pain kept dropping—it's almost gone now. That's the kind of progress I wasn't expecting. Dr. Wei actually listens instead of just running through the motions. She explains what she's doing and why, so nothing feels vague. The sessions are calm, no rushing. What impressed me most is that she doesn't just focus on the pain itself—we talked about my habits, stress, how I sleep, how I move through the day. That bigger-picture thinking makes a real difference. Before considering injections or other more invasive options, I'd definitely consult with Dr. Wei. She's changed how I think about acupuncture.

author: Anonymous

author: Jaideep Asokan
text: 03/12/2026 Had a massage appointment with Katie who I've been seeing for many years. Today I saw that the clients were being selectively greeted by the counter staff. For me a look up and a terse statement that the masseuse had stepped out for a bit and will be back. Sure. Maybe customer service is not her forte and she also does not realize that she is the face of the establishment. Next customer who is a lady, the receptionist springs up from her chair with a dazzling smile,greets the customer by her name and escorts her all the way to the back. Doesn't faze me but other customers may not take it lightly. I've known Blair since 2006 and Katie since at least 2019. So I will continue coming here. These are times when clients will dearly miss Crystal with her gentle smile and adorable manners. Oh well. This is the changing face of Canada I guess. Friendly customer service cannot be taken for granted anymore. I will still give Nosecreek 5 stars because of how nice and professional Katie and Blair are to people at all times.
